app.name: Gym & Spa
app.description: Manage members, subscriptions, payments and the spa — even without internet

connection.title: Connection
connection.connectedHint: The app is connected to the server.
connection.offlineHint: This device isn't connected to a network. Nothing can be saved until the connection is back.
connection.unreachableHint: The server isn't responding. Nothing can be saved until it's back.

pwa.offlineReady: The app is ready and will open faster
pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of the app is ready
pwa.updateHint: The page reloads and the app locks. Unlock it with your PIN.
pwa.unsavedText: If you update now, what you typed and haven't saved is lost.

search.placeholderMembers: Search for a member or a page...
search.hint: Type a name, phone number or member number, or hold the member's card to the card reader.
search.failed: Couldn't search the members. Check the connection and try again.
search.allMembers: All results in the members list

errors.notFoundHint: The link may be wrong or the page may have been removed.
errors.unexpectedHint: Sorry, something went wrong. Try again. If the problem continues, tell a manager.

saveErrors.network: Couldn't reach the server, so nothing was saved. Check your internet and try again.
saveErrors.gym_read_only: This gym is view-only, so nothing can be changed.
saveErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
saveErrors.invalid: This information isn't valid, so it wasn't saved.
saveErrors.unexpected: It wasn't saved. Try again. If it keeps happening, tell a manager.

billing.endingText: This gym's subscription ends on {{date}} (days left: {{days}}). To renew it, contact Click Group.
billing.graceText: This gym's subscription ended on {{endedOn}}. From {{readOnlyOn}} the gym will be view-only (days left: {{days}}). To renew it, contact Click Group.
billing.suspendedText: Click Group has suspended this gym: you can see all its data, but nothing can be added or changed. Contact Click Group.
billing.endedText: This gym's subscription has ended: you can see all its data, but nothing can be added or changed. To renew the subscription, contact Click Group.

license.endingText: This gym's license ends on {{date}} ({{days}} days left). To renew it, contact Click Group and put the new code on the server PC.
license.graceText: This gym's license ended on {{endedOn}}. From {{readOnlyOn}} the gym is view-only ({{days}} days left). To renew it, contact Click Group.
license.endedText: This gym's license has ended: you can see everything, but nothing can be added or changed. To renew the license, contact Click Group.
license.notActivatedTitle: The server PC is not activated
license.notActivatedText: Until the activation code is put on the server PC, the gym is view-only. Send the machine code to Click Group.
license.wrongMachineTitle: The activation code is not for this PC
license.wrongMachineText: The activation code is for another PC (for example, Windows was installed again). Until a new code is put on it, the gym is view-only. Contact Click Group.
license.clockTitle: The server PC's clock is wrong
license.clockText: The server PC's clock went back more than two days. Until it is right again, the gym is view-only.
license.brokenText: This version does not accept the license. Contact Click Group for a new one.
license.updatesEndingText: Updates to the program last until {{date}} ({{days}} days left). After that this version keeps working, but newer versions cannot be installed. To buy more updates, contact Click Group.
license.updatesEndedText: This version keeps working, but newer versions cannot be installed until you buy updates. Contact Click Group.

serverVersion.title: This PC's version doesn't match the server
serverVersion.text: This PC has version {{app}} and the server has version {{server}}. Install the same version on every PC of the gym, then open the app again.

noAccess.title: You can't open this page
noAccess.description: Your role doesn't include this. Ask your manager if you need it.
